facts.title: Rules of the Muscogee District Court
facts.detail: Court rules page; rule 1 says new members of the Muscogee (Creek) Nation Bar Association receive a copy of the rules on payment of admission fees. A Word file of the rules is linked (Rules-of-the-MCN-District-Court.docx, uploaded 2024-05).
facts.quote: Rules of the Muscogee District Court

facts.title: Rules of the Muscogee District Court (Rule 1, Bar Association references)
facts.detail: The rules mention a Muscogee (Creek) Nation Bar Association and admission fees, but this page does not set out an application process or fee amount.
facts.quote: New members of the Muscogee (Creek) Nation Bar Association will be presented a copy of the Rules upon payment of admission fees.
facts.note: Only an indirect reference; no admission procedure page found. Confidence set low because it gives no process.

facts.title: Cherokee Nation Court Rules

facts.title: Cherokee Nation Bar Association
facts.detail: Applicants complete an application with an original certificate of good standing from a state bar and submit it to the Supreme Court Clerk; the Justices review it and the process usually takes about 45 days; bar fees are paid only after admission. The page links a Bar Member Application, Oath of Attorney, Supreme Court Attorney Rules Nos. 130-139, bar dues order and by-laws.
facts.quote: To become a bar member, you must complete an application with original documentation of good standing
